title: Google Search AI Mode Reportedly Attributed Another Person's Criminal Conviction to a German Physician
summary: Google Search's AI Mode is reported to have falsely attributed another person's conviction for sexual coercion to a physician in Germany, putting his professional reputation at risk. After Google declined his removal request, the Aachen Regional Court issued a preliminary injunction barring Google Ireland Limited from repeating the statements in AI Mode.
